headline: The dragon came through the door
lede: ADVENTURE's rooms stopped being a cage: a dragon hunting you now follows through any doorway you run out of, and the bite — or the sword-turn — lands inside the new room. Along the way the shift caught the factory's own scoreboard lying about which games are weak.

notes.text: Room-warp seam law: a living, jaw-open dragon aligned on the doorway warps through with you at the mirror entry — no dice, every barrier law intact, multi-dragon rooms reachable for the first time. 196 gates, 52 mutants die.

The never-dry pick this session was nearly a phantom: idle-kick aimed at PINBALL, whose only remaining gap awaits an open decision (#3335). Manual re-derivation found parseRegistry blind to all 21 statically-imported titles — ADVENTURE sat at 15 unowned gaps, the true weakest by a distance. Filed as #3440 with repro.

Dead sessions leave tails: #3195 was fixed three days before its close, #3432 merged without its labels or polish pass. Verified, closed, and filed #3446 (PINBALL) and #3447 (SKYWARD) so the QA lane has the second rounds it never got.

look.text: ADVENTURE — stand near Rhindle at the lair's top gap and run up
